personality_one_liner: A cinematic, minimal, and intensely luxurious voice-first oracle, bridging deep midnight void with glowing crystal-pink elegance and regal gold.

spacing.rule: Maintain generous breathing room to achieve an editorial, luxury aesthetic. Use precise vertical rhythm. Avoid dense packing.

do's: Use heavy tint (≥75% of surface) underneath glass on dark mode to ensure text is readable against the lush crystal pink background.
Apply glass to bottom tab bars, sticky headers, and bottom sheets.
Use glass for the answer reveal card that slides up from the bottom over the hero background.
dont's: Never blur body text regions or form fields.
Don't stack more than two blur surfaces on one screen.

screens.name: Home (Oracle)
screens.purpose: Extraordinary minimal luxury landing with a single primary interaction: a glowing central voice orb to consult the oracle.

states.loading: Subtle pulsing gold ring around the orb.
states.empty: Idle: 'Tap to ask' with the text input field visible above the orb.
states.error: Frosted glass snackbar dropping from the top with an error message and a retry icon.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image (lush pink crystal) layered with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to 90% surface at the bottom). A minimalistic top bar showing tonight's moon phase. The core UI sits in the lower half: a clean text input floating directly above a large, prominent glowing crystal/lotus orb (the primary focal point). Transitions map to states: 'Consulting...' (fluid audio processing animation), 'VELORA speaks' (audio waveform). The final answer slides up gracefully as a frosted glass sheet covering the lower half of the screen.

screens.name: Customer Dashboard (Journal)
screens.purpose: An exceptionally simple, premium, uncluttered private reading journal.

states.loading: Dark shimmer skeletons mimicking the layout of glass rows.
states.empty: Minimalistic gold constellation or crystal illustration with text: 'Your journal is empty. Ask the oracle to begin.'
states.error: Centered readable message with a gold 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Solid midnight background (surface). A scrollable, clean list of past questions and answers. Each session is a glass-effect card or subtly separated by thin dividers. Audio replay buttons on each row. Avoid complex navigation or dense meta-data; prioritize typography and generous padding.

screens.name: Owner Dashboard
screens.purpose: A comprehensive control center hidden from customers, emphasizing utility without sacrificing the luxury aesthetic.

states.loading: Centered gold spinner over a dark surface.
states.error: Error message with a clean retry action.

screens.layout: Top section features sleek, glass-morphic metric cards (Total Sessions, Users). Below, a clean line chart for 'Last 7 Days'. Following are distinct sections for Member Management and Branding Controls. Modular layout using surfaceSecondary cards with lg margins.

screens.name: Account / Profile
screens.layout: Generous vertical spacing. Profile identity at the top. A premium segmented control for language switching (EN/HI/Hinglish). A subtle Role Badge (Owner/Customer). A minimalist sign-out button anchored at the bottom.

screens.name: Login / Forgot Password

states.loading: Button label shifts to a subtle loading animation.

screens.layout: Centered luxury gold VELORA logo. Clean input fields using surfaceTertiary background and thin gold focus rings. A prominent primary CTA (Login) and a secondary text link for Forgot Password. The pink crystal background faintly blurred behind a heavy dark scrim.

hero_backdrop.alt: Lush pink and magenta crystal abstract background

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Glass / Luxe DARK personality guidelines. Keep the entire UI dark, using deep midnight/obsidian blacks (#050508) as the root surface, accented with gold (#D4AF37) and luminous soft pink (#D28CA7).

Font hierarchy is critical for this editorial/luxury feel: Use Cormorant Garamond exclusively for large headings, display text, and numbers (where a serif looks elegant). Use Satoshi (max weight 500) for all body copy, inputs, tabs, and buttons.

Implement the MANDATORY gradient-to-dark scrim pattern on the Home and Login screens where the hero_backdrop image is used. The scrim must fade from transparent at the top to ≥90% surface (#050508) at the bottom so that the text input and voice orb are perfectly readable and grounded.

The central interaction on the Home screen must be singularly focused. A single glowing orb placed in the lower-middle with the text input right above it. Animate state changes (Tap to speak -> Consulting -> VELORA speaks) fluidly without abruptly jumping between screens.

When revealing the text answer/transcript on the Home screen, slide up a glass sheet (expo-glass-effect or expo-blur with heavy underlying tint) over the background instead of navigating to a new flat screen.
Use Phosphor icons with a thin or light weight to match the premium, refined serif typography. Avoid chunky or filled icons except for the active tab.
Ensure all buttons have a minimum touch target of 44x44pt and employ subtle haptics (Haptics.impactAsync) on press. Map these in the haptics block for the development agent.
